title: A Museum Tour
description: Four recordings about a visit to a museum: buying tickets, a guide's tour, a talk about the dinosaur room and a closing announcement.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · At the ticket desk
parts.intro: You will hear a family buying tickets at a museum.

script.speaker: Clerk
script.text: Good morning. Welcome to the City Museum. How many tickets would you like?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Two adults and two children, please. My son is nine, and my daughter is six.

script.speaker: Clerk
script.text: Children under seven are free. So that's two adults and one child. Adults are eight pounds, and the child is four pounds.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: So, that's twenty pounds altogether. Is there a tour today?

script.speaker: Clerk
script.text: Yes, there's a guided tour at eleven o'clock. It starts in the main hall and lasts about an hour.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Wonderful. And where can I leave our coats? It's quite warm today.

script.speaker: Clerk
script.text: There are free lockers behind the shop. You need a pound coin, but you get it back.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Thank you. Is there a place to have lunch?

script.speaker: Clerk
script.text: Yes, the café is on the second floor. It's closed on Mondays, but it's open today.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Great. Here is the money. Thanks for your help.

parts.title: Part 2 · The guided tour
parts.intro: You will hear a guide, Mr Hill, talking to a group in the museum.

script.speaker: Mr Hill
script.text: Good morning, everyone. My name is Mr Hill, and I'll be your guide today. Please stay together, and don't touch anything.

script.speaker: Mr Hill
script.text: This building is more than two hundred years old. It was first a school, and it became a museum in nineteen fifty.

script.speaker: Mr Hill
script.text: In this room, you can see old clocks. The oldest clock is from sixteen hundred, and it still works. Listen, can you hear it?

script.speaker: Mr Hill
script.text: Next, we go upstairs to the art room. Here we have pictures of the city from many years ago. My favourite is the painting of the old bridge.

script.speaker: Mr Hill
script.text: You can take photos in this room, but please turn off the flash. It can damage the old paintings.

script.speaker: Mr Hill
script.text: After the art room, we visit the dinosaur room. That is the most popular room for children, so I'll save it for the end.

parts.title: Part 3 · The dinosaur room
parts.intro: You will hear Mr Hill and a girl called Mai in the dinosaur room.

script.speaker: Mr Hill
script.text: Here we are, the dinosaur room. Does anybody know how big this dinosaur was?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I think it was as big as a bus!

script.speaker: Mr Hill
script.text: Good guess, Mai, but actually it was bigger. It was about twelve metres long, as long as two buses.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Wow! What did it eat?

script.speaker: Mr Hill
script.text: This one ate plants. The one over there, with the big teeth, ate meat. You can see it was dangerous.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I'm glad I didn't live then! Are those eggs?

script.speaker: Mr Hill
script.text: Yes, they are. Scientists found them in the desert about thirty years ago. Each egg is as big as a football.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: That's amazing. Can I touch one?

script.speaker: Mr Hill
script.text: I'm sorry, Mai. These are real, so we can only look. But in the next room there are models that you can touch.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: That's fine. This is the best day ever!

parts.title: Part 4 · An announcement
parts.intro: You will hear an announcement at the museum at the end of the day.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: Good afternoon, ladies and gentlemen. The museum will close in thirty minutes, at half past five.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: Please remember to collect your things from the lockers, and do not forget your pound coin.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: If you want a souvenir, our shop is open until five twenty-five. This week, all postcards are half price, and there is a special book about dinosaurs for children.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: Tomorrow, the museum has a family day. There will be free painting classes in the art room from ten until twelve. You do not need to book.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: Thank you for visiting the City Museum. We hope to see you again soon.
